title: How Micron’s Building Biggest U.S. Chip Fab, Despite China Ban
text:
返回首页

全文文稿

How Micron’s Building Biggest U.S. Chip Fab, Despite China Ban
CNBC
C1
完整 187 句
17:43
约 2790 词
644 个考试词
隐藏译文
复制全文
回到视频

点句首时间从那一句开始播放；带虚线的词是考试词，点开可看释义。

0:01
第 1 段 · 9 句
0:01

These actually have billions and many billions of memory bits, bits that store information in ones and zeros in them.

这些实际上拥有数十亿乃至数百亿的内存位，这些位以1和0的形式存储信息。

0:11

Data is at the center of all our devices and generative AI.

数据是所有设备和生成式人工智能的核心。

0:14

And accessing and storing that data requires these memory chips.

而访问和存储这些数据需要这些内存芯片。

0:19

And there's only one major memory maker based in the U.S. Micron. Micron.

而美国只有一家主要的内存制造商，那就是美光。美光。

0:23

Micron, the maker of basic DRAM chips, the building blocks of all memory.

美光，基本DRAM芯片的制造商，是所有存储器的基石。

0:26

Micron's stock is up more than 30 percent since the start of the year, largely thanks to generative AI hype.

美光科技的股价自年初以来上涨超过30%，主要得益于生成式人工智能的热潮。

0:32

And while memory is a simpler,

而且尽管内存是一种更简单的、

0:33

cheaper type of semiconductor than the high-powered central processing units and graphics processing units sending other chip stocks through the roof,

比那些推动其他芯片股飙升的高性能中央处理器和图形处理器更便宜的半导体类型，

0:41

multiple memory chips are needed to support eac
